content.title: Admissions & Financial Aid | Pomona College in Claremont, California - Pomona College
content.text: Skip to main content Jump to Fast Facts 24% of our students are the first in their family to attend college 7:1 Student to faculty ratio on average 95% live on campus all four years, creating a tight community 250+ student-run clubs and organizations to choose from Admissions We seek bright, talented and driven students from all over the world. Application Components First-Year Admissions We admit a first-year class representing a broad range of interests, viewpoints, talents and backgrounds. Pomona is need-blind for U.S. citizens, permanent residents, eligible non-citizens (such as refugees) and undocumented students who graduate from a high school in the United States. Transfer Info and Deadlines Transfer Admissions We admit transfer students as sophomores or juniors, and welcome applicants who have attended community colleges, public and international universities, private colleges, and those who have military experience. Tuition & Financial Aid Pomona College is one of a handful of institutions committed to need-blind admissions for domestic students and meeting the full demonstrated financial need of the students who enroll.More than half of Pomona students receive some form of financial aid. The Need-Based Financial Aid commitment means a student's financial need is determined after a careful review of each family's financial documents. We do our best to take into account each family's unique circumstances. Need-Based Financial Aid Cost of Attendance Estimate Your Aid Apply for Aid
